dc:title: ECHOREPO Soil Dataset: soil observations, parameters, images and biodiversity
dc:description: Canonical ECHOREPO soil data resources with machine-readable CSVW metadata for SoilWise interoperability.
dc:creator: Osychenko, Oleg

tables.dc:title: ECHOREPO analysis methods
tables.dc:description: Reference table defining the compact laboratory method codes used by sample_parameters.csv and parameter_definitions.csv, including short names, full method descriptions and reviewed procedure URIs where available.

columns.name: method_code
columns.description: Compact code identifying the laboratory analysis method. The method is defined in analysis_methods.csv.

columns.name: method_name
columns.description: Short human-readable name of the laboratory method represented by method_code.

columns.name: method_description
columns.description: Human-readable description of the laboratory procedure represented by method_code.

columns.name: procedure_uri
columns.description: Persistent URI identifying the laboratory procedure represented by method_code, where a reviewed vocabulary mapping is available.

tables.dc:title: ECHOREPO parameter definitions
tables.dc:description: Reference table defining the compact parameter codes used in sample_parameters.csv. It provides human-readable names, reviewed semantic URIs, default units, method codes and parameter descriptions.

columns.name: parameter_code
columns.description: Compact code identifying the measured elemental parameter. The corresponding human-readable definition and semantic URI are given in parameter_definitions.csv.

columns.name: parameter_name
columns.description: Human-readable name of the parameter identified by parameter_code.

columns.name: parameter_uri
columns.description: Persistent URI identifying the soil property or elemental concentration represented by parameter_code, where a reviewed mapping is available.

columns.name: default_unit
columns.description: Default human-readable unit associated with the parameter definition. The actual unit for each measurement is retained in sample_parameters.csv.

columns.name: method_code
columns.description: Compact code identifying the laboratory analysis method. The method is defined in analysis_methods.csv.

columns.name: parameter_description
columns.description: Human-readable description of the parameter represented by parameter_code.

tables.dc:title: ECHOREPO sample microbial biodiversity observations
tables.dc:description: Microbial taxonomic abundance statistics by reported taxonomic rank associated with ECHOREPO samples and molecular markers. The ingested_datetime_utc field is an ECHOREPO ingestion timestamp, not a laboratory analysis timestamp.

columns.name: sample_id
columns.description: Unique identifier of the ECHOREPO soil sample.

columns.name: country_code
columns.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code associated with the published sample location.

columns.name: marker
columns.description: Molecular marker or assay target used for the microbial biodiversity observation, for example 16S or ITS.

columns.name: taxon_rank
columns.description: Taxonomic rank at which the microbial abundance result is reported, for example Phylum.

columns.name: scientific_name
columns.description: Scientific name assigned to the microbial taxon by the source biodiversity workflow.

columns.name: read_count
columns.description: Number of sequencing reads assigned to the reported taxon for the corresponding sample and molecular marker. This is a sequencing-read count, not a count of organisms.

columns.name: relative_abundance_pct
columns.description: Relative abundance percentage reported for the taxon in the corresponding sample and molecular-marker aggregation.

columns.name: ingested_datetime_utc
titles: Biodiversity result ingestion date and time
columns.description: Date and time at which the biodiversity abundance row was uploaded/ingested into ECHOREPO, normalized to UTC. The source is sample_taxon_abundance.uploaded_at; it must not be interpreted as the laboratory analysis date.

columns.name: source_file
columns.description: Name of the source biodiversity file from which the canonical abundance row was derived.

columns.name: licence
columns.description: Licence statement associated with the row or source data.

tables.dc:title: ECHOREPO sample images
tables.dc:description: Image resources and image metadata associated with ECHOREPO soil samples. Image URLs should resolve to public HTTPS resources before Zenodo publication.

columns.name: sample_id
columns.description: Unique identifier of the ECHOREPO soil sample.

columns.name: country_code
columns.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code associated with the published sample location.

columns.name: image_id
columns.description: Identifier of an image associated with an ECHOREPO soil sample.

columns.name: image_url
columns.description: Public URL from which the image associated with the sample can be accessed.

columns.name: image_description_orig
columns.description: Participant-provided image description in the original submitted language.

columns.name: image_description_en
columns.description: English representation or translation of the image description.

columns.name: collected_by
columns.description: Internal or pseudonymous identifier associated with the participant or process that collected the record. Publication of this field should be reviewed against the ECHO privacy/consent policy.

columns.name: image_datetime_utc
columns.description: Date and time associated with the image record, normalized to UTC in ISO 8601 format.

columns.name: licence
columns.description: Licence statement associated with the row or source data.

tables.dc:title: ECHOREPO sample laboratory parameters
tables.dc:description: Compact long-form elemental concentration measurements associated with ECHOREPO soil samples. parameter_code refers to parameter_definitions.csv and method_code refers to analysis_methods.csv, avoiding repetition of human-readable labels, descriptions and semantic URIs in every measurement row.

columns.name: sample_id
columns.description: Unique identifier of the ECHOREPO soil sample.

columns.name: country_code
columns.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code associated with the published sample location.

columns.name: parameter_code
columns.description: Compact code identifying the measured elemental parameter. The corresponding human-readable definition and semantic URI are given in parameter_definitions.csv.

columns.name: result_value
columns.description: Numeric measurement result. The measured property is identified by parameter_code and defined in parameter_definitions.csv.

columns.name: unit
columns.description: Unit in which result_value is expressed for this measurement, for example mg/kg.

columns.name: method_code
columns.description: Compact code identifying the laboratory analysis method. The method is defined in analysis_methods.csv.

columns.name: analysis_datetime_utc
columns.description: Date and time associated with the laboratory analysis, normalized to UTC in ISO 8601 format.

columns.name: lab_id
columns.description: Identifier of the laboratory or laboratory workflow responsible for the measurement.

columns.name: licence
columns.description: Licence statement associated with the row or source data.

tables.dc:title: ECHOREPO canonical soil samples
tables.dc:description: Canonical sample-level ECHOREPO records for discrete 0-30 cm soil sampling events, including published location, field-estimated soil pH, soil organic matter estimate, earthworm count, visible-pollutant observations, soil structure, soil texture and free-text observations.

columns.name: sample_id
columns.description: Unique identifier of the ECHOREPO soil sample.

columns.name: sampling_datetime_utc
columns.description: Date and time at which the soil sampling event was recorded, normalized to UTC in ISO 8601 format.

columns.name: lat
columns.description: Latitude of the published sample location in decimal degrees using WGS 84 (EPSG:4326).

columns.name: lon
columns.description: Longitude of the published sample location in decimal degrees using WGS 84 (EPSG:4326).

columns.name: country_code
columns.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code associated with the published sample location.

columns.name: coordinate_obfuscation_radius_m
columns.description: Radius, in metres, used to spatially obfuscate the published sample coordinates in ECHOREPO for privacy protection. The published latitude and longitude represent an obfuscated location rather than the exact sampling point.

columns.name: soil_ph_field
columns.description: Soil pH estimated with the ECHO paper-strip protocol: mixed soil is added to distilled water until the mixture reaches 14 mL, shaken for 30 seconds, settled for 5 minutes, then a pH strip is immersed for 30 seconds and compared with the ECHO App colour chart.
columns.method: ECHO simplified soil pH paper-strip method

columns.name: soil_organic_matter_estimate_pct
columns.description: Estimated soil organic matter (SOM) percentage selected by visually comparing a spoonful of mixed soil with the ECHO App soil-colour chart. This is a field estimate of SOM and must not be interpreted as laboratory-measured soil organic carbon.
columns.method: ECHO visual soil-colour chart estimation of soil organic matter

columns.name: earthworms_count
columns.description: Number of earthworms manually found while breaking apart the soil excavated from the ECHO sampling pit and recorded in the ECHO App.

columns.name: contamination_debris
columns.description: Numeric ECHOREPO field derived from the ECHO visual-pollutant observation workflow for visible debris. The field protocol requires participants to observe visible fragments and record number and size; the exact encoding of this canonical field still needs to be confirmed.
columns.method: ECHO visual inspection for visible pollutants in and around the sampling pit

columns.name: contamination_plastic
columns.description: Numeric ECHOREPO field derived from the ECHO visual-pollutant observation workflow for visible plastic. The exact encoding of this canonical field still needs to be confirmed.
columns.method: ECHO visual inspection for visible pollutants in and around the sampling pit

columns.name: contamination_other_orig
columns.description: Participant-provided free-text information about other visible contamination or possible contamination sources, in the original submitted language.

columns.name: contamination_other_en
columns.description: English representation or translation of participant-provided information about other visible contamination or possible contamination sources.

columns.name: pollutants_count
columns.description: Count field associated with the ECHO visible-pollutant observation workflow. The precise set of items represented by this count still needs to be confirmed from the app/export mapping.
columns.method: ECHO visual inspection for visible pollutants in and around the sampling pit

columns.name: soil_structure_orig
columns.description: Soil-structure class recorded by the participant using the ECHO simplified VESS assessment, in the original submitted language.
columns.method: ECHO simplified Visual Evaluation of Soil Structure (VESS), adapted from Ball et al. (2007)

columns.name: soil_structure_en
columns.description: English representation of the soil-structure class recorded using the ECHO simplified VESS assessment.
columns.method: ECHO simplified Visual Evaluation of Soil Structure (VESS), adapted from Ball et al. (2007)

columns.name: soil_texture_orig
columns.description: Soil-texture class recorded by the participant using the ECHO texture-by-feel workflow, in the original submitted language.
columns.method: ECHO texture-by-feel method adapted from the USDA soil quality guide

columns.name: soil_texture_en
columns.description: English representation of the soil-texture class recorded using the ECHO texture-by-feel workflow.
columns.method: ECHO texture-by-feel method adapted from the USDA soil quality guide

columns.name: observations_orig
columns.description: Additional free-text observations submitted by the participant in the original language.

columns.name: observations_en
columns.description: English representation or translation of the participant's additional free-text observations.

columns.name: metals_info_orig
columns.description: Participant-provided free-text contextual information concerning metals or possible metal contamination, in the original submitted language.

columns.name: metals_info_en
columns.description: English representation or translation of participant-provided contextual information concerning metals or possible metal contamination.

columns.name: collected_by
columns.description: Internal or pseudonymous identifier associated with the participant or process that collected the record. Publication of this field should be reviewed against the ECHO privacy/consent policy.

columns.name: data_source
columns.description: Source system or workflow from which the canonical record was derived, for example the ECHO mobile application.

columns.name: qa_status
columns.description: ECHOREPO quality-assurance status assigned to the canonical sample record.

columns.name: licence
columns.description: Licence statement associated with the row or source data.

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Sampling method
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: ECHO discrete soil sampling protocol: one sampling location per kit, using a 30 x 30 x 30 cm soil pit after removing litter and surface material.
